reuse.why: Adds shared predicates in shared/schedules.ts and keeps using getDateWithSkippedWeekend, and removes a duplicated ternary in schedule-template via a local closure.

duplication.why: The combined 'skipWeekend && !skipsWeekendOccurrences ? move : keep' plus 'drop if isDroppedWeekendOccurrence' decision is re-assembled separately in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and createScheduleList.

placement.why: The daily-skip predicate lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getDateWithSkippedWeekend; the per-site composition stays in the consumers, which is where the tree already had it.

scope.why: Only the weekend-rule sites, the frequency field needed in parseRecurDate, and tests.

maintainability.why: The full weekend rule (skip for daily, move otherwise) has no single owner; a future change must touch three call sites that each mix predicates and the move helper slightly differently.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All sites use the new predicates and getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: The skip-or-move decision is reshaped at each site: moveWeekendOccurrence closure plus filter in schedule-template.ts, filter/map chain in schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates, and skipsWeekends/find logic in shared getNextDate.

one_place.where: Predicates are shared (skipsWeekendOccurrences, isDroppedWeekendOccurrence) but whether to drop or move a date is decided at three sites rather than in one function.
